verdict.rationale: Convex's core positioning is a reactive database where queries automatically push live updates to the UI without polling ('Real-time sync so your users instantly see the latest data', 'live-updating apps', 'queries are TypeScript code running right in the database'), and community discussion confirms Convex's distinguishing 'reactivity story' versus alternatives. Missing for 10: detailed first-party API docs on the specific subscribe/useQuery mechanics and an independent hands-on benchmark/demo verifying real-time update latency.
